name: POST /admin/byok/bindings/:binding_id/revoke — api-gateway
description: Revokes a tenant CMK binding, recording the mandatory reason and operator_id for the audit trail, and returns 200 { success: true, data: <binding> } with the now-revoked binding. QA edge cases: reason and operator_id are both required with a falsy check (empty strings rejected) — revocation is never allowed to be unattributed; an unknown binding_id is a clean 404 "binding not found" because revokeCmk() returning null is handled explicitly, unlike the sibling rotate route which 500s in the same situation; revoking an already-revoked binding depends on revokeCmk returning the row (200) versus null (404), so assert on the returned status rather than assuming idempotency; propagation to readers is bounded by the binding's sla_revoke_propagation_seconds, so a revoked key can still decrypt for a short window after this call returns 200.

errorCases.when: requireAdmin() found no valid x-admin-ops-token header — missing, or matching neither env ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN nor an active admin.ops_token hash (30s cache TTL applies to revocations)
reason or operator_id is missing, null, or an empty string in the body
revokeCmk() returns null/undefined — no binding exists with that binding_id (or it is no longer revocable)
revokeCmk() throws — KMS unreachable, the audit/DB write failing, or Postgres unavailable

testCases.name: Revoke a tenant's BYOK CMK binding (renders data undecryptable)
